environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed in a VPC with an S3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) configured with a custom endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses a StringEquals condition on the 'aws:ResourceAccount' condition key restricting to the owning account (123456789012), combined with a StringLike condition on 's3:prefix' requiring 'uploads/general/*' OR 'uploads/documents/*' patterns only. Additionally, the policy includes a Deny statement for any PutObject where the bucket ARN does not match 'arn:aws:s3:::customer-documents-prod'. The Lambda execution role has the same broad s3:PutObject permission, but all S3 traffic is forced through the VPC endpoint (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway on Lambda subnets). The endpoint policy is the sole egress control for S3 API calls.

config.network: VPC with S3 gateway endpoint only, no NAT, no IGW on Lambda subnets
